decision.rationale: The saved official MacIsaac School of Nursing homepage describes nursing education, institutional history, Indigenous cultural safety, health-disparities research and student leadership. Preserve academic guidance as the default while routing the explicit research, news, event and career sections according to their published purpose.
evidence: https://macisaacnursing.ubc.ca/ | 94207820e1c82bc13f1b1af6a3ff8cfbc0d5d7c898f93bfbca93b84cb9acae8b | The School was among UBC's first academic programs and the Commonwealth's first nursing program to offer a university degree.
https://macisaacnursing.ubc.ca/ | 94207820e1c82bc13f1b1af6a3ff8cfbc0d5d7c898f93bfbca93b84cb9acae8b | The homepage identifies research to reduce health disparities and links /research.

https://macisaacnursing.ubc.ca/ | 94207820e1c82bc13f1b1af6a3ff8cfbc0d5d7c898f93bfbca93b84cb9acae8b | The homepage separately labels News, Events and Careers with links under /community/news, /community/events and /about/careers.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly identifies the /research section as health-disparities research and scholarship.
The homepage explicitly labels the /community/news section and dated entries as school news.
Published event and career sections provide opportunities to attend or apply.

fallback.rationale: Nursing education, curriculum, institutional mission and student academic guidance.
